extraction_note: ZoomMD provides NO data dictionary, NO schema, and NO field-level documentation. The only EHI export documentation is a 4-page PDF (ZoomMD_EHI_Export_Format_Specification.pdf) that describes the UI workflow for triggering an export but provides zero detail about what data entities or fields are exported. The export format is a ZIP file containing C-CDA R2.1 documents, PDFs, HTML clinical notes, and image files. Without a data dictionary or sample export, it is impossible to enumerate specific entities or fields.
export_format: ZIP containing C-CDA R2.1, PDF, HTML, and image files

documented_content_types.description: Clinical Document Architecture documents following C-CDA R2.1 Companion Guide Release 2. No specification of which sections or templates are populated.
PDF documents, scanned paper, and digital records of faxes
